event_text: The Bandaranaike Airport attack is carried out by 14 Tamil Tiger commandos, resulting in military and civilian casualties and destroyed aircraft.
story: Oi'll tell yer, Susan me luv, I'm playin' Velupillai Prabhakaran, leader o' them Tamil Tigers, an' I've got a right ol' plan, ain't I? (winkin' at the audience) Me an' me 14 mates, we sneak into Bandaranaike Airport, sneaky like pigeons, an' blow the whole bloomin' thing to kingdom come! (dramatic flappin' o' wings) Susan, you're playin' the Sri Lankan Army, an' you're all, "Blimey, guvna, what's all the commotion?" An' I'm all, "Kaboom, mate! You've got 14 dead, 15 injured, an' a right mess o' mangled aircraft!" (in a deadpan aside) Yeah, it was a real hoot, innit? (back to the drama) An' that, me friend, were the dark day o' July 24, 2001, when the Tigers brought terror to the skies, an' I, Barry the pigeon, were the mastermind behind it aaaaall! (maniacal laugh)
